appended.name: Keller Group plc
appended.suggestion: The screen emits strong_buy (11/22, five families including cheapness/quality/GARP/dividend/risk) while statutory NI is flat, Lynch PEG fails at 1.76, Earnings Yield fails (7.3%<8%), P/E 13.8 is above the Low-P/E hurdle, PEGY=0.05 contradicts that PEG, and cyclical_exposure_detected is false on a geotech contractor whose H1 narrative is NA data-centre/infra versus weak Europe/residential. Overlays are all false: fcf_basis_overlay despite 168m vs 189.6m FCF tagged USD, leverage_override unused on a near-net-cash but provision-heavy contractor, cash_conversion_overlay, and cyclical_exposure. Quality/Buffett can pass on 25% ROE created partly by shrinking share count. The director–worker loop is being asked to qualitatively veto a mechanically clean headline that sector-cycle and FCF-currency overlays failed to brake.

RSI 50 + SMA200 +0.33% timing=neutral is not a substitute for those monitors.

appended.name: Keller Group plc
appended.suggestion: A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend statutory and underlying geotech margins and will not force North America versus EME, data-centre/infrastructure versus residential, order-book secured versus variation, plant-capex FCF versus company-adjusted FCF, or cash versus IFRS-16 net debt. No required slot for reporting-currency hygiene (snapshot USD vs sterling accounts) or for ‘July TU and I-40 exist as unread bodies’. Director catalog pass can form these questions without drafting the memo.
